# Objetivo

Este notebook audita el panel a nivel `id_tarjeta` antes de reestimar modelos.
La unidad de analisis deja de ser el viaje y pasa a ser la tarjeta como proxy
operacional de usuario.

El flujo sera incremental. Este primer bloque revisa solamente:

- universo disponible;
- distribucion del target;
- cobertura de residencia;
- sensibilidad a filtros `home_confidence` y minimo de viajes.

No se estiman modelos en este notebook.

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")

def pct_expr(num: pl.Expr, den: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.when(den == 0).then(None).otherwise(num / den)


def target_distribution(lf: pl.LazyFrame, label: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    totals = lf.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("total_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("total_trips"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)

    return (
        lf.group_by("tipo_tarjeta")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns(
            [
                pl.lit(label).alias("universe"),
                (pl.col("n_cards") / totals["total_cards"]).alias("card_share"),
                (pl.col("n_trips") / totals["total_trips"]).alias("trip_share"),
            ]
        )
        .select(["universe", "tipo_tarjeta", "n_cards", "card_share", "n_trips", "trip_share"])
        .sort(["universe", "tipo_tarjeta"])
        .collect()
    )


def filter_home(lf: pl.LazyFrame, home_values: list[str] | None) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    if home_values is None:
        return lf
    return lf.filter(pl.col("home_confidence").is_in(home_values))


def threshold_sensitivity(lf: pl.LazyFrame, home_label: str, home_values: list[str] | None) -> pl.DataFrame:
    base = filter_home(lf, home_values)
    totals = base.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("base_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("base_trips"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)

    rows = []
    for threshold in THRESHOLDS:
        subset = base.filter(pl.col("n_viajes") >= threshold)
        row = subset.select(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_card_share"),
                pl.col("is_qr_red").mean().alias("qr_red_card_share"),
                pl.col("is_qr_other").mean().alias("qr_other_card_share"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_n_viajes"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.90).alias("p90_n_viajes"),
            ]
        ).collect().row(0, named=True)
        row["home_filter"] = home_label
        row["min_n_viajes"] = threshold
        row["card_retention_vs_filter"] = row["n_cards"] / totals["base_cards"] if totals["base_cards"] else None
        row["trip_retention_vs_filter"] = row["n_trips"] / totals["base_trips"] if totals["base_trips"] else None
        rows.append(row)

    return pl.DataFrame(rows).select(
        [
            "home_filter",
            "min_n_viajes",
            "n_cards",
            "card_retention_vs_filter",
            "n_trips",
            "trip_retention_vs_filter",
            "qr_card_share",
            "qr_red_card_share",
            "qr_other_card_share",
            "median_n_viajes",
            "p90_n_viajes",
        ]
    )
```

# Bloque 1 — Universo, target y filtros base

## 1.1 Universo disponible

```{python}

                pl.lit("clean").alias("universe"),
                pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
                pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),

                pl.col("home_confidence").is_in(["alta", "media"]).sum().alias("home_alta_media_cards"),
```

## 1.5 Universos candidatos para modelar

```{python}
#| label: block1-candidate-universes
print("label: block1-candidate-universes")

candidate_specs = [
    ("clean_all", None, 1),
    ("clean_home_alta", ["alta"], 1),
    ("clean_home_alta_n3", ["alta"], 3),
    ("clean_home_alta_n5", ["alta"], 5),
    ("clean_home_alta_n10", ["alta"], 10),
    ("clean_home_alta_media", ["alta", "media"], 1),
    ("clean_home_alta_media_n3", ["alta", "media"], 3),
    ("clean_home_alta_media_n5", ["alta", "media"], 5),
    ("clean_home_alta_media_n10", ["alta", "media"], 10),
]

candidate_rows = []
for label, home_values, min_n in candidate_specs:
    subset = filter_home(lf_clean, home_values).filter(pl.col("n_viajes") >= min_n)
    row = subset.select(
        [
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
            pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_card_share"),
            pl.col("is_qr_red").mean().alias("qr_red_card_share"),
            pl.col("is_qr_other").mean().alias("qr_other_card_share"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("median_n_viajes"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.90).alias("p90_n_viajes"),
        ]
    ).collect().row(0, named=True)
    row["candidate"] = label
    row["home_filter"] = "all" if home_values is None else "+".join(home_values)
    row["min_n_viajes"] = min_n
    candidate_rows.append(row)

candidate_universes = pl.DataFrame(candidate_rows).select(
    [
        "candidate",
        "home_filter",
        "min_n_viajes",
        "n_cards",
        "n_trips",
        "qr_card_share",
        "qr_red_card_share",
        "qr_other_card_share",
        "median_n_viajes",

    ]
)
```

# Bloque 2 — Exposicion y ocasionalidad

Objetivo: caracterizar intensidad y duracion de uso por tarjeta, y como
difieren entre BIP y QR_RED/QR_OTHER. Esto fundamenta la eleccion del umbral
minimo de viajes.

Preguntas guia:

- Cuantos viajes tiene una tarjeta tipica.
- BIP vs QR_RED vs QR_OTHER tienen distinta intensidad de uso.
- Cuantas tarjetas se pierden con cada umbral.
- Los ocasionales son principalmente BIP o QR.

Variables: `n_viajes`, `n_dias_activos`, `n_semanas_activas`, `trip_span_days`,
`share_trips_2025`.

## 2.1 Percentiles de exposicion por target

```{python}
#| label: block2-exposure-percentiles
print("label: block2-exposure-percentiles")

EXPOSURE_VARS = ["n_viajes", "n_dias_activos", "n_semanas_activas",
                 "trip_span_days", "share_trips_2025"]
PCTS = [0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99]


def exposure_percentiles(lf: pl.LazyFrame, group_col: str, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = []
    for v in vars:
        aggs.append(pl.col(v).mean().alias(f"{v}__mean"))
        for q in PCTS:
            aggs.append(pl.col(v).quantile(q).alias(f"{v}__p{int(q*100):02d}"))
    return (
        lf.group_by(group_col)
        .agg(aggs + [pl.len().alias("n_cards")])
        .sort(group_col)
        .collect()
    )


exposure_by_target = exposure_percentiles(lf_clean, "tipo_tarjeta", EXPOSURE_VARS)
exposure_by_target
```

## 2.4 Composicion del target por bucket de n_viajes

```{python}
#| label: block2-target-by-trip-bucket
print("label: block2-target-by-trip-bucket")

bucket_expr = (
    pl.when(pl.col("n_viajes") == 1).then(pl.lit("01_n=1"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes") == 2).then(pl.lit("02_n=2"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes").is_between(3, 4)).then(pl.lit("03_n=3-4"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes").is_between(5, 9)).then(pl.lit("04_n=5-9"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes").is_between(10, 19)).then(pl.lit("05_n=10-19"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes").is_between(20, 49)).then(pl.lit("06_n=20-49"))
    .when(pl.col("n_viajes") >= 50).then(pl.lit("07_n>=50"))
    .otherwise(pl.lit("99_otro"))
    .alias("n_viajes_bucket")
)

target_by_bucket = (
    lf_clean.with_columns(bucket_expr)
    .group_by(["n_viajes_bucket", "tipo_tarjeta"])
    .agg([
        pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
        pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
    ])
    .with_columns([
        (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over("n_viajes_bucket"))
            .alias("card_share_within_bucket"),
    ])
    .sort(["n_viajes_bucket", "tipo_tarjeta"])
    .collect()
)
target_by_bucket
```

## 2.5 Curva de retencion: tarjetas y viajes por umbral

```{python}
#| label: block2-retention-curve
print("label: block2-retention-curve")

retention_grid = list(range(1, 51))

retention_rows = []
totals_clean = lf_clean.select([
    pl.len().alias("base_cards"),
    pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("base_trips"),
]).collect().row(0, named=True)

for thr in retention_grid:
    s = lf_clean.filter(pl.col("n_viajes") >= thr).select([
        pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
        pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
        pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_card_share"),
    ]).collect().row(0, named=True)
    retention_rows.append({
        "min_n_viajes": thr,
        "card_retention": s["n_cards"] / totals_clean["base_cards"],
        "trip_retention": s["n_trips"] / totals_clean["base_trips"],
        "qr_card_share": s["qr_card_share"],
    })
retention_df = pd.DataFrame(retention_rows)

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax1.plot(retention_df["min_n_viajes"], retention_df["card_retention"],
         marker="o", color="C0", label="retencion tarjetas")
ax1.plot(retention_df["min_n_viajes"], retention_df["trip_retention"],
         marker="s", color="C1", label="retencion viajes")
ax1.set_xlabel("Umbral min n_viajes")
ax1.set_ylabel("Retencion (proporcion del clean)")
ax1.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax1.legend(loc="center left")

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(retention_df["min_n_viajes"], retention_df["qr_card_share"],
         marker="^", color="C3", label="qr_card_share")
ax2.set_ylabel("share QR")
ax2.legend(loc="center right")

for thr in [3, 5, 10]:
    ax1.axvline(thr, color="grey", ls=":", alpha=0.5)

ax1.set_title("Retencion vs umbral n_viajes (clean panel)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

retention_df.set_index("min_n_viajes").loc[[1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50]]
```

# Bloque 2b — Vista binaria QR vs BIP

Objetivo: replicar los analisis clave del Bloque 2 colapsando QR_RED y
QR_OTHER en una sola clase QR. Esto evalua si el target binario es
defendible o si la separacion multiclase aporta sustantivamente.

## 2b.4 Curva qr_share binario vs umbral

```{python}
#| label: block2b-retention-binary
print("label: block2b-retention-binary")

# reutilizar retention_df (ya tiene qr_card_share), agregar comparacion BIP-share
retention_binary = retention_df.copy()
```

```{python}
]

    base = lf_clean.filter(pl.col("home_confidence") == "alta")
    if min_nv is not None:
        base = base.filter(pl.col("n_viajes") >= min_nv)
    if min_hd is not None:
        base = base.filter(pl.col("n_home_dest_trips_card") >= min_hd)
    row = base.select([
        pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
        pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
        pl.col("is_qr_red").mean().alias("qr_red_share"),
        pl.col("is_qr_other").mean().alias("qr_other_share"),
        pl.col("n_home_dest_trips_card").quantile(0.50).alias("home_dest_trips_p50"),
        pl.col("n_viajes").quantile(0.50).alias("n_viajes_p50"),
    ]).collect().row(0, named=True)
    row["filter"] = label
    scenario_rows.append(row)

scenarios_df = pl.DataFrame(scenario_rows).select([
    "filter", "n_cards", "qr_share", "qr_red_share", "qr_other_share",
    "home_dest_trips_p50", "n_viajes_p50"
])
```

## 4.2 Distribucion global (percentiles, missing, outliers)

```{python}
#| label: block4-distributions
print("label: block4-distributions")

DIST_PCTS = [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99]


def distribution_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for v in vars:
        stats = lf.select([
            pl.col(v).is_null().mean().alias("missing_rate"),
            pl.col(v).mean().alias("mean"),
            pl.col(v).std().alias("std"),
            pl.col(v).min().alias("min"),
            pl.col(v).max().alias("max"),
        ] + [pl.col(v).quantile(q).alias(f"p{int(q*100):02d}") for q in DIST_PCTS]
        ).collect().row(0, named=True)
        stats["variable"] = v
        rows.append(stats)
    cols = ["variable", "missing_rate", "mean", "std", "min", "max"] + \
           [f"p{int(q*100):02d}" for q in DIST_PCTS]
    return pl.DataFrame(rows).select(cols)


dist_horario = distribution_table(lf_clean, HORARIO_VARS)
dist_horario
```

## 4.3 Comparacion mediana por target

```{python}
#| label: block4-median-by-target
print("label: block4-median-by-target")


def median_by_target(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    for v in vars:
        aggs.append(pl.col(v).median().alias(f"{v}__median"))
        aggs.append(pl.col(v).mean().alias(f"{v}__mean"))
    return (
        lf.group_by("tipo_tarjeta")
        .agg(aggs)
        .sort("tipo_tarjeta")
        .collect()
    )


# imprimir transpuesto para legibilidad
```

```{python}
#| label: block4-corr-heatmap

import numpy as np

# sample para correlaciones
sample_n = min(500_000, lf_clean.select(pl.len()).collect().item())

# usar Spearman por robustez ante asimetrias
corr = df_corr.corr(method="spearman")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 11))
im = ax.imshow(corr.values, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(corr.columns)))
ax.set_yticks(range(len(corr.columns)))
ax.set_xticklabels(corr.columns, rotation=90, fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticklabels(corr.columns, fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="Spearman r")
ax.set_title("Heatmap de correlaciones (Spearman) — variables de uso")

# anotar |r| >= 0.5 con valor
for i in range(len(corr)):
    for j in range(len(corr)):
        if i == j:
            continue
        v = corr.iloc[i, j]
        if abs(v) >= 0.5:
            ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center",
                    color="white" if abs(v) > 0.75 else "black", fontsize=7)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Bloque 5 — Geografia y contexto

Objetivo: evaluar si la señal QR se concentra mas por residencia o por zonas
frecuentes de actividad, y decidir si los modelos deben incluir macrozona de
residencia, macrozona de origen frecuente o ambas.

Universo usado en este bloque:

- panel limpio;
- `home_confidence == "alta"`;
- `n_viajes >= 3`.

Este universo coincide con el candidato principal preliminar para modelos.
Mapas por zona hogar/origen top-1 quedan fuera de este primer paso.

Preguntas guia:

- QR se concentra por residencia o por zonas frecuentes de actividad.
- Que aporta macrozona de residencia vs origen frecuente.
- Las zonas top-1/top-2 son estables o demasiado dispersas.

## 5.2 Share QR por macrozona

```{python}
#| label: block5-qr-share-by-macrozone
print("label: block5-qr-share-by-macrozone")


def qr_share_by_group(lf: pl.LazyFrame, group_col: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return (
        lf.filter(pl.col(group_col).is_not_null())
        .group_by(group_col)
        .agg([
            pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
            pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            pl.col("is_qr_other").mean().alias("qr_other_share"),
            pl.col("is_qr_red").mean().alias("qr_red_share"),
            pl.col("n_viajes").median().alias("n_viajes_p50"),
            pl.col("origin_zone_top1_share").median().alias("origin_top1_share_p50"),
            pl.col("activity_zone_top1_share").median().alias("activity_top1_share_p50"),
        ])
        .sort("n_cards", descending=True)
        .collect()
    )


macro_home = qr_share_by_group(lf_geo, "home_macrozone").with_columns(
    pl.lit("home_macrozone").alias("macro_source")
)
macro_origin = qr_share_by_group(lf_geo, "origin_top1_macrozone").with_columns(
    pl.lit("origin_top1_macrozone").alias("macro_source")
)
macro_activity = qr_share_by_group(lf_geo, "activity_top1_macrozone").with_columns(
    pl.lit("activity_top1_macrozone").alias("macro_source")
)

macro_qr_summary = pl.concat(
    [
        macro_home.rename({"home_macrozone": "macrozone"}),
        macro_origin.rename({"origin_top1_macrozone": "macrozone"}),
        macro_activity.rename({"activity_top1_macrozone": "macrozone"}),
    ],
    how="diagonal_relaxed",
).select([
    "macro_source", "macrozone", "n_cards", "n_trips",
    "qr_share", "qr_other_share", "qr_red_share",
    "n_viajes_p50", "origin_top1_share_p50", "activity_top1_share_p50",
])

macro_qr_summary
```

```{python}
#| label: block5-target-wide-by-macrozone
print("label: block5-target-wide-by-macrozone")


def target_wide_by_group(lf: pl.LazyFrame, group_col: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = (
        lf.filter(pl.col(group_col).is_not_null())
        .group_by([group_col, "tipo_tarjeta"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards"))
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_cards") / pl.col("n_cards").sum().over(group_col)).alias("card_share")
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    wide = (
        base.pivot(index=group_col, columns="tipo_tarjeta", values="card_share")
        .fillna(0)
        .reset_index()
        .rename_axis(None, axis=1)
    )
    sizes = (
        lf.filter(pl.col(group_col).is_not_null())
        .group_by(group_col)
        .agg(pl.len().alias("n_cards"))
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    return sizes.merge(wide, on=group_col, how="left").sort_values("n_cards", ascending=False)


target_home_wide = target_wide_by_group(lf_geo, "home_macrozone")
target_origin_wide = target_wide_by_group(lf_geo, "origin_top1_macrozone")
target_activity_wide = target_wide_by_group(lf_geo, "activity_top1_macrozone")

print("home_macrozone")
display(target_home_wide)
print("origin_top1_macrozone")
display(target_origin_wide)
print("activity_top1_macrozone")
display(target_activity_wide)
```

## 5.4 Estabilidad espacial: top-1/top-2 y entropia

```{python}
#| label: block5-spatial-stability-distributions
print("label: block5-spatial-stability-distributions")


def geo_distribution_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    pcts = [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99]
    rows = []
    for v in vars:
        stats = lf.select([
            pl.col(v).is_null().mean().alias("missing_rate"),
            pl.col(v).mean().alias("mean"),
            pl.col(v).std().alias("std"),
            pl.col(v).min().alias("min"),
            pl.col(v).max().alias("max"),
        ] + [pl.col(v).quantile(q).alias(f"p{int(q*100):02d}") for q in pcts]).collect().row(0, named=True)
        stats["variable"] = v
        rows.append(stats)
    return pl.DataFrame(rows).select(
        ["variable", "missing_rate", "mean", "std", "min", "max"]
        + [f"p{int(q*100):02d}" for q in pcts]
    )


geo_stability_dist = geo_distribution_table(lf_geo, GEO_STABILITY_COLS)
geo_stability_dist
```

# Bloque 6A — Socioeconomia residencial

Objetivo: auditar las variables socioeconomicas medidas en zona de residencia
antes de definir el set parsimonioso para logit y el set amplio para ML.

Este bloque tambien aporta evidencia para decidir entre target binario y
multiclase: si QR_RED y QR_OTHER tienen patrones socioeconomicos distintos,
conviene mantener el analisis multiclase como frente relevante.

Universo usado:

- panel limpio;
- `home_confidence == "alta"`;
- `n_viajes >= 3`.

```{python}
#| label: block6a-socio-distributions
print("label: block6a-socio-distributions")


def socio_distribution_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    pcts = [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99]
    rows = []
    for v in vars:
        stats = lf.select([
            pl.col(v).is_null().mean().alias("missing_rate"),
            pl.col(v).mean().alias("mean"),
            pl.col(v).std().alias("std"),
            pl.col(v).min().alias("min"),
            pl.col(v).max().alias("max"),
        ] + [pl.col(v).quantile(q).alias(f"p{int(q*100):02d}") for q in pcts]).collect().row(0, named=True)
        stats["variable"] = SOCIO_LABELS.get(v, v)
        stats["raw_variable"] = v
        rows.append(stats)
    return pl.DataFrame(rows).select(
        ["variable", "raw_variable", "missing_rate", "mean", "std", "min", "max"]
        + [f"p{int(q*100):02d}" for q in pcts]
    )
```

## 6A.3 Medias y medianas por target

```{python}
#| label: block6a-socio-by-target
print("label: block6a-socio-by-target")


def mean_median_by_target(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    aggs = [pl.len().alias("n_cards")]
    for v in vars:
        label = SOCIO_LABELS.get(v, v)
        aggs.append(pl.col(v).mean().alias(f"{label}__mean"))
        aggs.append(pl.col(v).median().alias(f"{label}__median"))
    return (
        lf.group_by("tipo_tarjeta")
        .agg(aggs)
        .sort("tipo_tarjeta")
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
        .set_index("tipo_tarjeta")
        .T
    )


socio_by_target = mean_median_by_target(lf_socio, SOCIO_RES_VARS)
```

## 6A.4 Auditoria de variables sensibles

Antes de interpretar cuantiles, se auditan dos puntos:

- `res_share_mujeres_z` tiene un minimo extremo y podria estar afectado por
  zonas con denominadores pequenos o problemas de estandarizacion.
- `res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z` debe leerse correctamente:
  segun la documentacion del reporte territorial, `DE` corresponde a una
  mayor concentracion zonal de hogares en tramos bajos D+E proxy. Por tanto,
  valores altos de esta variable apuntan a mayor concentracion relativa de
  hogares D+E proxy, no a mayor ingreso.

```{python}
#| label: block6a-audit-mujeres-outlier

    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) < -5).sum().alias("n_cards_mujeres_z_lt_minus5"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) < -3).sum().alias("n_cards_mujeres_z_lt_minus3"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) > 3).sum().alias("n_cards_mujeres_z_gt_3"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) < -5).mean().alias("share_cards_mujeres_z_lt_minus5"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) < -3).mean().alias("share_cards_mujeres_z_lt_minus3"),
    (pl.col(MUJERES_VAR) > 3).mean().alias("share_cards_mujeres_z_gt_3"),
    pl.col(MUJERES_VAR).min().alias("min_mujeres_z"),
    pl.col(MUJERES_VAR).quantile(0.001).alias("p001_mujeres_z"),
    pl.col(MUJERES_VAR).quantile(0.01).alias("p01_mujeres_z"),
    pl.col(MUJERES_VAR).quantile(0.99).alias("p99_mujeres_z"),
]).collect()
```

```{python}
    tmp["quantile"] = pd.qcut(tmp[raw_var], q=5, labels=False, duplicates="drop")
    grouped = (

            qr_other_share=("is_qr_other", "mean"),
            qr_red_share=("is_qr_red", "mean"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    grouped["variable"] = label
    grouped["raw_variable"] = raw_var
    quantile_rows.append(grouped)

socio_quantiles = (

)
```

# Bloque 6B — Infraestructura/oferta por zonas frecuentes

Objetivo: auditar variables OSM de oferta/contexto urbano medidas en zonas
frecuentes de actividad: origen top-1, origen top-2 y actividad top-1.

Este bloque busca decidir si OSM entra al logit parsimonioso o queda como
sensibilidad/feature ampliada para ML.

Universo usado:

- panel limpio;
- `home_confidence == "alta"`;
- `n_viajes >= 3`.

## 6B.1 Catalogo y cobertura

```{python}
#| label: block6b-osm-setup
print("label: block6b-osm-setup")

OSM_MAIN_FILTER_DESC = "clean + home_alta + n_viajes>=3"
lf_osm = lf_clean.filter(
    (pl.col("home_confidence") == "alta")
    & (pl.col("n_viajes") >= 3)
)

OSM_FEATURES = [
    "osm_leisure_playground_density_km2_z",
    "osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z",
    "osm_amenity_university_density_km2_z",
    "osm_transport_shelter_yes_density_km2_z",
    "osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z",
]
OSM_PREFIXES = ["origin_top1", "origin_top2", "activity_top1"]
OSM_VARS = [f"{prefix}_{feature}" for prefix in OSM_PREFIXES for feature in OSM_FEATURES]

OSM_LABELS = {
    "osm_leisure_playground_density_km2_z": "playground",
    "osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z": "school",
    "osm_amenity_university_density_km2_z": "university",
    "osm_transport_shelter_yes_density_km2_z": "shelter",
    "osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z": "subway_entrance",
}

def osm_short_label(var: str) -> str:
    for prefix in OSM_PREFIXES:
        prefix_token = f"{prefix}_"
        if var.startswith(prefix_token):
            feature = var.removeprefix(prefix_token)
            return f"{prefix}_{OSM_LABELS.get(feature, feature)}"
    return var


schema_osm = lf_clean.collect_schema()
missing_osm = [c for c in OSM_VARS if c not in schema_osm.names()]
print(f"universo OSM: {OSM_MAIN_FILTER_DESC}")
print(f"variables OSM ausentes: {missing_osm}")
if missing_osm:
    raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas OSM: {missing_osm}")

osm_coverage = lf_osm.select([
    pl.len().alias("n_cards"),
    pl.col("n_viajes").sum().alias("n_trips"),
    pl.col("is_qr").mean().alias("qr_share"),
    pl.col("is_qr_red").mean().alias("qr_red_share"),
    pl.col("is_qr_other").mean().alias("qr_other_share"),
    *[pl.col(c).is_null().mean().alias(f"{osm_short_label(c)}__missing") for c in OSM_VARS],
]).collect()

osm_coverage
```

## 6B.2 Distribuciones globales

```{python}
#| label: block6b-osm-distributions
print("label: block6b-osm-distributions")


def osm_distribution_table(lf: pl.LazyFrame, vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    pcts = [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99]
    rows = []
    for v in vars:
        stats = lf.select([
            pl.col(v).is_null().mean().alias("missing_rate"),
            pl.col(v).mean().alias("mean"),
            pl.col(v).std().alias("std"),
            pl.col(v).min().alias("min"),
            pl.col(v).max().alias("max"),
        ] + [pl.col(v).quantile(q).alias(f"p{int(q*100):02d}") for q in pcts]).collect().row(0, named=True)
        stats["variable"] = osm_short_label(v)
        stats["raw_variable"] = v
        stats["source"] = v.split("_osm_")[0]
        rows.append(stats)
    return pl.DataFrame(rows).select(
        ["source", "variable", "raw_variable", "missing_rate", "mean", "std", "min", "max"]
        + [f"p{int(q*100):02d}" for q in pcts]
    )


osm_dist = osm_distribution_table(lf_osm, OSM_VARS)
osm_dist
```

```{python}
source_rows = []
for feature in OSM_FEATURES:

    cols_by_source = {prefix: f"{prefix}_{feature}" for prefix in OSM_PREFIXES}
    df_feature_sources = (
        lf_osm.select(list(cols_by_source.values()))
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
        .rename(columns={col: prefix for prefix, col in cols_by_source.items()})
    )

    for prefix in OSM_PREFIXES:
        row[f"{prefix}__mean"] = df_feature_sources[prefix].mean()
        row[f"{prefix}__p50"] = df_feature_sources[prefix].median()
    source_corr = df_feature_sources.corr(method="spearman")
    row["corr_origin_top1_top2"] = source_corr.loc["origin_top1", "origin_top2"]
    row["corr_origin_top1_activity_top1"] = source_corr.loc["origin_top1", "activity_top1"]
    source_rows.append(row)
```

# Bloque 6C — Colinealidad conjunta y sets candidatos

Objetivo: revisar redundancias entre bloques antes de pasar a modelamiento.
Este bloque junta socioeconomia residencial, macrozonas, uso agregado y un OSM
reducido para cerrar:

- set logit parsimonioso;
- sensibilidades econometricas prioritarias;
- set amplio para ML.

Universo usado:

- panel limpio;
- `home_confidence == "alta"`;
- `n_viajes >= 3`.

## 6C.1 Construccion de variables candidatas

```{python}
#| label: block6c-feature-setup
print("label: block6c-feature-setup")

JOINT_MAIN_FILTER_DESC = "clean + home_alta + n_viajes>=3"
lf_joint = lf_clean.filter(
    (pl.col("home_confidence") == "alta")
    & (pl.col("n_viajes") >= 3)
)

JOINT_SOCIO_BASE = [
    "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
    "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z",
    "res_prom_edad_z",
    "res_share_discapacidad_z",
    "res_share_inmigrantes_z",
    "res_share_asistencia_parv_z",
]

JOINT_USAGE_BASE = [
    "share_trips_2025",
    "n_viajes",
    "n_dias_activos",
    "n_semanas_activas",
    "hora_mean",
    "hora_std",
    "share_lab_pm",
    "share_lab_pt",
    "share_no_lab",
    "share_trips_with_transfer",
    "t_vehiculo_mean_min",
    "t_espera_ini_mean_min",
    "share_trips_solo_metro",
    "share_trips_metro_bus",
]

JOINT_MACRO_BASE = [
    "home_macro_norte",
    "home_macro_poniente",
    "home_macro_oriente",
    "home_macro_sur",
    "home_macro_suroriente",
    "home_macro_externa_especial",
    "origin_top1_macro_norte",
    "origin_top1_macro_poniente",
    "origin_top1_macro_oriente",
    "origin_top1_macro_sur",
    "origin_top1_macro_suroriente",
    "origin_top1_macro_externa_especial",
]

JOINT_OSM_REDUCED = [
    "origin_top1_osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z",
]

UNIVERSITY_VAR = "origin_top1_osm_amenity_university_density_km2_z"

# Dummies/transformaciones candidatas para sensibilidad, no main.
joint_university_cutoff = lf_joint.select(
    pl.col(UNIVERSITY_VAR).quantile(0.75).alias("p75")
).collect().item()
joint_mujeres_bounds = lf_joint.select([
    pl.col("res_share_mujeres_z").quantile(0.01).alias("p01"),
    pl.col("res_share_mujeres_z").quantile(0.99).alias("p99"),
]).collect().row(0, named=True)

lf_joint_features = (
    lf_joint
    .with_columns([
        pl.col("res_share_mujeres_z").clip(
            joint_mujeres_bounds["p01"],
            joint_mujeres_bounds["p99"],
        ).alias("res_share_mujeres_z_winsor_p01_p99"),
        (pl.col(UNIVERSITY_VAR) > joint_university_cutoff)
        .cast(pl.Int8)
        .alias("origin_top1_university_high_dummy"),
    ])
)

JOINT_OPTIONAL_SENSITIVITY = [
    "res_share_mujeres_z_winsor_p01_p99",
    "origin_top1_university_high_dummy",
    "origin_top1_osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z",
    "origin_zone_top1_share",
    "origin_zone_entropy",
]

JOINT_ALL_REVIEW = (
    JOINT_SOCIO_BASE
    + JOINT_USAGE_BASE
    + JOINT_MACRO_BASE
    + JOINT_OSM_REDUCED
    + JOINT_OPTIONAL_SENSITIVITY
)

JOINT_LABELS = {
    "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z": "res_educacion",
    "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z": "res_de_proxy",
    "res_prom_edad_z": "res_edad",
    "res_share_discapacidad_z": "res_discapacidad",
    "res_share_inmigrantes_z": "res_inmigrantes",
    "res_share_asistencia_parv_z": "res_parv",
    "res_share_mujeres_z_winsor_p01_p99": "res_mujeres_winsor",
    "origin_top1_osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z": "origin_school",
    "origin_top1_osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z": "origin_subway",
    "origin_top1_university_high_dummy": "origin_university_high",
}

schema_joint = lf_clean.collect_schema()
missing_joint = [c for c in JOINT_ALL_REVIEW if c not in schema_joint.names() and c not in JOINT_OPTIONAL_SENSITIVITY]
print(f"universo conjunto: {JOINT_MAIN_FILTER_DESC}")
print(f"university p75 cutoff: {joint_university_cutoff:.6f}")
print(
    "mujeres winsor bounds: "

)
```

# Bloque 7 — Separabilidad supervisada inicial

Objetivo: diagnosticar si existe senal real para separar:

- `QR vs BIP`;
- `QR_OTHER vs BIP`;
- `QR_RED vs QR_OTHER`;
- `QR_RED vs BIP` solo como diagnostico.

Este bloque no define el modelo final. Sirve para priorizar variables,
transformaciones e interacciones antes de estimar logit/ML.

## 7B. Ranking univariado por target pairwise

Metricas:

- `std_diff`: diferencia de medias estandarizada, positivo significa mayor
  valor en la clase positiva.
- `auc`: AUC univariado. Si es menor que 0,5, se invierte para reportar
  `auc_abs`, porque la variable separa pero en direccion negativa.
- `avg_precision_best`: mejor average precision entre score original y score invertido.
- `lift_top10`: prevalencia de la clase positiva en el 10% superior del score
  dividido por la prevalencia base. Se calcula tambien invirtiendo el signo y
  se reporta el mejor lift.

```{python}
#| label: block7b-univariate-ranking
print("label: block7b-univariate-ranking")

from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, roc_auc_score

BLOCK7_CANDIDATE_VARS = [
    # Socioeconomia residencial.
    *JOINT_SOCIO_BASE,
    "res_share_mujeres_z_winsor_p01_p99",

    # Exposicion / cohorte.
    "share_trips_2025",
    "n_viajes",
    "n_dias_activos",
    "n_semanas_activas",

    # Uso horario, operacional y modal.
    "hora_mean",
    "hora_std",
    "share_lab_pm",
    "share_lab_pt",
    "share_no_lab",
    "share_trips_with_transfer",
    "t_vehiculo_mean_min",
    "t_espera_ini_mean_min",
    "share_trips_solo_metro",
    "share_trips_metro_bus",

    # Geografia.
    *JOINT_MACRO_BASE,
    "origin_zone_top1_share",
    "origin_zone_entropy",

    # OSM reducido/sensibilidad.
    "origin_top1_osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z",
    "origin_top1_university_high_dummy",
    "origin_top1_osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z",
]

BLOCK7_LABELS = {
    **JOINT_LABELS,
    "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z": "res_educacion",
    "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z": "res_de_proxy",
    "res_prom_edad_z": "res_edad",
    "res_share_discapacidad_z": "res_discapacidad",
    "res_share_inmigrantes_z": "res_inmigrantes",
    "res_share_asistencia_parv_z": "res_parv",
    "origin_top1_osm_amenity_school_density_km2_z": "origin_school",
    "origin_top1_osm_railway_subway_entrance_density_km2_z": "origin_subway",
}

schema_7 = lf_joint_features.collect_schema()
BLOCK7_CANDIDATE_VARS = [
    v for v in dict.fromkeys(BLOCK7_CANDIDATE_VARS)
    if v in schema_7.names()
]
print(f"variables candidatas ranking univariado: {len(BLOCK7_CANDIDATE_VARS)}")


def top_fraction_lift(y: pd.Series, score: pd.Series, top_fraction: float = 0.10) -> float:
    valid = pd.DataFrame({"y": y, "score": score}).dropna()
    if valid.empty:
        return float("nan")
    base_rate = valid["y"].mean()
    if base_rate == 0:
        return float("nan")
    top_n = max(1, int(len(valid) * top_fraction))
    top_rate = valid.nlargest(top_n, "score")["y"].mean()
    return top_rate / base_rate


def univariate_screen_for_pair(pair_name: str, spec: dict, vars_: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = (
        spec["lf"]
        .select(["target_pair", *vars_])
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

    y = df["target_pair"].astype(int)
    rows = []
    for raw_var in vars_:
        x = pd.to_numeric(df[raw_var], errors="coerce")
        valid = pd.DataFrame({"y": y, "x": x}).dropna()
        n_valid = len(valid)
        if n_valid == 0 or valid["y"].nunique() < 2 or valid["x"].nunique() < 2:
            continue

        x_pos = valid.loc[valid["y"] == 1, "x"]
        x_neg = valid.loc[valid["y"] == 0, "x"]
        pooled_std = valid["x"].std(ddof=0)
        std_diff = (x_pos.mean() - x_neg.mean()) / pooled_std if pooled_std else float("nan")

        auc = roc_auc_score(valid["y"], valid["x"])
        auc_abs = max(auc, 1 - auc)
        direction = 1 if auc >= 0.5 else -1

        avg_precision_high = average_precision_score(valid["y"], valid["x"])
        avg_precision_low = average_precision_score(valid["y"], -valid["x"])
        avg_precision_best = max(avg_precision_high, avg_precision_low)
        avg_precision_direction = "high" if avg_precision_high >= avg_precision_low else "low"
        lift_top10_high = top_fraction_lift(valid["y"], valid["x"], top_fraction=0.10)
        lift_top10_low = top_fraction_lift(valid["y"], -valid["x"], top_fraction=0.10)
        lift_top10_best = max(lift_top10_high, lift_top10_low)
        lift_direction = "high" if lift_top10_high >= lift_top10_low else "low"

        rows.append({
            "pair": pair_name,
            "description": spec["description"],
            "variable": BLOCK7_LABELS.get(raw_var, raw_var),
            "raw_variable": raw_var,
            "n_valid": n_valid,
            "missing_rate": 1 - (n_valid / len(df)),
            "positive_rate": valid["y"].mean(),
            "std_diff": std_diff,
            "auc": auc,
            "auc_abs": auc_abs,
            "auc_direction": direction,
            "avg_precision_best": avg_precision_best,
            "avg_precision_direction": avg_precision_direction,
            "lift_top10_best": lift_top10_best,
            "lift_top10_direction": lift_direction,
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


screen_frames = [
    univariate_screen_for_pair(pair_name, spec, BLOCK7_CANDIDATE_VARS)
    for pair_name, spec in PAIRWISE_SPECS.items()
]

block7_univariate = pd.concat(screen_frames, ignore_index=True)
block7_univariate_top = (
    block7_univariate
    .assign(rank_score=lambda d: (d["auc_abs"] - 0.5).abs())
    .sort_values(["pair", "rank_score", "lift_top10_best"], ascending=[True, False, False])
    .drop(columns=["rank_score"])
)

block7_univariate_top.groupby("pair").head(15)
```

## 7D. Bins y franjas sin interacciones

Objetivo: revisar si variables con señal debil en continuo tienen cortes no
lineales utiles, especialmente para `QR_OTHER vs BIP`.

```{python}
#| label: block7d-bin-setup
print("label: block7d-bin-setup")

def qcut_series(s: pd.Series, q: int = 5, prefix: str = "Q") -> pd.Series:
    valid = s.dropna()
    if valid.nunique() < 2:
        return pd.Series(pd.NA, index=s.index, dtype="object")
    try:
        bins = pd.qcut(s, q=q, duplicates="drop")
    except ValueError:
        return pd.Series(pd.NA, index=s.index, dtype="object")
    if bins.cat.categories.empty:
        return pd.Series(pd.NA, index=s.index, dtype="object")
    labels = [f"{prefix}{i + 1}" for i in range(len(bins.cat.categories))]
    return pd.qcut(s, q=q, labels=labels, duplicates="drop").astype("object")


def add_block7_bins(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()

    out["n_viajes_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["n_viajes"],
        bins=[2, 4, 9, 19, 49, float("inf")],
        labels=["03-04", "05-09", "10-19", "20-49", "50+"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["share_trips_2025_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["share_trips_2025"],
        bins=[-0.001, 0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 0.999, 1.0],
        labels=["solo_2024", "mayor_2024", "mixto", "mayor_2025", "solo_2025"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["hora_mean_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["hora_mean"],
        bins=[-0.001, 10, 13, 16, 19, 24],
        labels=["muy_temprano", "manana_mediodia", "tarde_temprana", "tarde", "noche"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["hora_std_bin"] = qcut_series(out["hora_std"], q=5, prefix="hora_std_Q")
    out["res_edad_q"] = qcut_series(out["res_prom_edad_z"], q=5, prefix="edad_Q")
    out["res_educacion_q"] = qcut_series(
        out["res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z"], q=5, prefix="educ_Q"
    )
    out["res_de_proxy_q"] = qcut_series(
        out["res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z"], q=5, prefix="de_Q"
    )
    out["res_discapacidad_q"] = qcut_series(out["res_share_discapacidad_z"], q=5, prefix="disc_Q")
    out["origin_entropy_q"] = qcut_series(out["origin_zone_entropy"], q=5, prefix="entropy_Q")

    out["share_no_lab_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["share_no_lab"],
        bins=[-0.001, 0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0],
        labels=["0", "bajo", "medio", "alto"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["share_lab_pt_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["share_lab_pt"],
        bins=[-0.001, 0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0],
        labels=["0", "bajo", "medio", "alto"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["solo_metro_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["share_trips_solo_metro"],
        bins=[-0.001, 0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0],
        labels=["0", "bajo", "medio", "alto"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    out["metro_bus_bin"] = pd.cut(
        out["share_trips_metro_bus"],
        bins=[-0.001, 0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0],
        labels=["0", "bajo", "medio", "alto"],
        include_lowest=True,
    ).astype("object")

    return out


BLOCK7_BIN_SOURCE_VARS = [
    "tipo_tarjeta",
    "is_qr",
    "is_qr_other",
    "is_qr_red",
    "n_viajes",
    "share_trips_2025",
    "hora_mean",
    "hora_std",
    "res_prom_edad_z",
    "res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z",
    "res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z",
    "res_share_discapacidad_z",
    "origin_zone_entropy",
    "share_no_lab",
    "share_lab_pt",
    "share_trips_solo_metro",
    "share_trips_metro_bus",
]

df_bins_base = (
    lf_joint_features
    .select(BLOCK7_BIN_SOURCE_VARS)
    .collect()
    .to_pandas()
)
df_bins = add_block7_bins(df_bins_base)

BLOCK7_BIN_VARS = [
    "n_viajes_bin",
    "share_trips_2025_bin",
    "hora_mean_bin",
    "hora_std_bin",
    "res_edad_q",
    "res_educacion_q",
    "res_de_proxy_q",
    "res_discapacidad_q",
    "origin_entropy_q",
    "share_no_lab_bin",
    "share_lab_pt_bin",
    "solo_metro_bin",
    "metro_bus_bin",
]

bin_setup_rows = []
for bin_var in BLOCK7_BIN_VARS:
    vc = df_bins[bin_var].value_counts(dropna=False)
    bin_setup_rows.append({
        "bin_variable": bin_var,
        "n_bins_including_na": len(vc),
        "missing_rate": df_bins[bin_var].isna().mean(),
        "min_bin_n": vc.min(),
        "max_bin_n": vc.max(),
    })

pd.DataFrame(bin_setup_rows)
```

```{python}
#| label: block7d-bin-rates
print("label: block7d-bin-rates")

def bin_rates_for_pair(df: pd.DataFrame, pair_name: str, bin_var: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if pair_name == "qr_vs_bip":
        tmp = df.assign(target_pair=df["is_qr"].astype(int))
    elif pair_name == "qr_other_vs_bip":
        tmp = df.loc[df["tipo_tarjeta"] != "QR_RED"].copy()
        tmp["target_pair"] = tmp["is_qr_other"].astype(int)
    elif pair_name == "qr_red_vs_other":
        tmp = df.loc[df["is_qr"] == 1].copy()
        tmp["target_pair"] = tmp["is_qr_red"].astype(int)
    elif pair_name == "qr_red_vs_bip_diag":
        tmp = df.loc[df["tipo_tarjeta"].isin(["BIP", "QR_RED"])].copy()
        tmp["target_pair"] = tmp["is_qr_red"].astype(int)
    else:
        raise ValueError(pair_name)

    tmp = tmp.loc[tmp[bin_var].notna()].copy()
    if tmp.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    base_rate = tmp["target_pair"].mean()
    g = (
        tmp.groupby(bin_var, observed=True)
        .agg(
            n_cards=("target_pair", "size"),
            positive_rate=("target_pair", "mean"),
            n_positive=("target_pair", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={bin_var: "bin"})
    )
    g["pair"] = pair_name
    g["description"] = PAIRWISE_SPECS[pair_name]["description"]
    g["bin_variable"] = bin_var
    g["base_rate"] = base_rate
    g["lift_vs_base"] = g["positive_rate"] / base_rate if base_rate else pd.NA
    g["share_of_pair"] = g["n_cards"] / len(tmp)
    return g[[
        "pair", "description", "bin_variable", "bin",
        "n_cards", "share_of_pair", "positive_rate", "base_rate",
        "lift_vs_base", "n_positive",
    ]]


bin_rate_frames = []
for pair_name in PAIRWISE_SPECS:
    for bin_var in BLOCK7_BIN_VARS:
        bin_rate_frames.append(bin_rates_for_pair(df_bins, pair_name, bin_var))

block7_bin_rates = pd.concat(bin_rate_frames, ignore_index=True)
block7_bin_rates
```

```{python}
#| label: block7d-bin-extremes
print("label: block7d-bin-extremes")

# Resumen compacto: para cada variable/pair mostrar el bin con mayor lift y
# el bin con menor tasa positiva. Filtrar bins demasiado chicos.
MIN_BIN_CARDS = 10_000

eligible_bins = block7_bin_rates.query("n_cards >= @MIN_BIN_CARDS").copy()

max_lift = (
    eligible_bins
    .sort_values(["pair", "bin_variable", "lift_vs_base"], ascending=[True, True, False])
    .groupby(["pair", "bin_variable"], as_index=False)
    .head(1)
    .assign(extreme="max_lift")
)

min_rate = (
    eligible_bins
    .sort_values(["pair", "bin_variable", "positive_rate"], ascending=[True, True, True])
    .groupby(["pair", "bin_variable"], as_index=False)
    .head(1)
    .assign(extreme="min_rate")
)

block7_bin_extremes = (
    pd.concat([max_lift, min_rate], ignore_index=True)
    .sort_values(["pair", "extreme", "lift_vs_base"], ascending=[True, True, False])
)

for pair_name in PAIRWISE_SPECS:
    print(f"\n=== {pair_name}: {PAIRWISE_SPECS[pair_name]['description']} ===")
    display(
        block7_bin_extremes
        .query("pair == @pair_name and extreme == 'max_lift'")
        .sort_values("lift_vs_base", ascending=False)
        .head(12)
        [[
            "bin_variable", "bin", "n_cards", "share_of_pair",
            "positive_rate", "base_rate", "lift_vs_base",
        ]]
    )
```

## 7F. Probe con arbol interpretable

Objetivo: probar si las flags derivadas de bins tienen valor combinado. Este
arbol no es modelo final; se usa como diagnostico de separabilidad.

```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
```

```{python}
#| label: block7f-tree-probe-run
print("label: block7f-tree-probe-run")

TREE_RANDOM_STATE = 42
TREE_MAX_DEPTH = 4
TREE_MIN_LEAF = 20_000


def binary_tree_probe(df: pd.DataFrame, task_name: str, mask: pd.Series, target_col: str) -> dict:
    data = df.loc[mask, [target_col, *TREE_PROBE_FEATURES]].dropna().copy()
    X = data[TREE_PROBE_FEATURES]
    y = data[target_col].astype(int)

    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )
    clf = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
        min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    pred = clf.predict(X_test)

    return {
        "task": task_name,
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": y.mean(),
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "macro_f1": f1_score(y_test, pred, average="macro"),
        "roc_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, proba),
        "avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, proba),
        "log_loss": log_loss(y_test, proba),
        "model": clf,
        "X_test": X_test,
        "y_test": y_test,
        "proba_test": proba,
        "pred_test": pred,
    }


def multiclass_tree_probe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    data = df.loc[
        df["tipo_tarjeta"].isin(["BIP", "QR_OTHER", "QR_RED"]),
        ["tipo_tarjeta", *TREE_PROBE_FEATURES],
    ].dropna().copy()
    label_order = ["BIP", "QR_OTHER", "QR_RED"]
    y = pd.Categorical(data["tipo_tarjeta"], categories=label_order).codes
    X = data[TREE_PROBE_FEATURES]

    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )
    clf = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
        min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test)
    pred = clf.predict(X_test)

    return {
        "task": "multiclass_bip_qrother_qrred",
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": None,
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
        "macro_f1": f1_score(y_test, pred, average="macro"),
        "roc_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, proba, multi_class="ovr", average="macro"),
        "avg_precision": None,
        "log_loss": log_loss(y_test, proba, labels=[0, 1, 2]),
        "model": clf,
        "X_test": X_test,
        "y_test": y_test,
        "proba_test": proba,
        "pred_test": pred,
        "label_order": label_order,
    }


tree_probe_results = []

tree_probe_results.append(binary_tree_probe(
    df_tree_probe,
    "qr_other_vs_bip",
    df_tree_probe["tipo_tarjeta"] != "QR_RED",
    "is_qr_other",
))
tree_probe_results.append(binary_tree_probe(
    df_tree_probe,
    "qr_vs_bip",
    df_tree_probe["tipo_tarjeta"].isin(["BIP", "QR_OTHER", "QR_RED"]),
    "is_qr",
))
tree_probe_results.append(multiclass_tree_probe(df_tree_probe))

tree_probe_metrics = pd.DataFrame([
    {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in {
        "model", "X_test", "y_test", "proba_test", "pred_test", "label_order"
    }}
    for r in tree_probe_results
])
tree_probe_metrics
```

```{python}
#| label: block7f-tree-probe-leaves
print("label: block7f-tree-probe-leaves")

def binary_leaf_summary(result: dict, top_n: int = 15) -> pd.DataFrame:
    clf = result["model"]
    X_test = result["X_test"]
    y_test = pd.Series(result["y_test"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    leaf_id = clf.apply(X_test)
    out = (
        pd.DataFrame({"leaf": leaf_id, "y": y_test, "proba": result["proba_test"]})
        .groupby("leaf")
        .agg(
            n=("y", "size"),
            positive_rate=("y", "mean"),
            mean_proba=("proba", "mean"),
            n_positive=("y", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    out["task"] = result["task"]
    out["base_rate"] = y_test.mean()
    out["lift_vs_base"] = out["positive_rate"] / out["base_rate"]
    return out.sort_values(["lift_vs_base", "n"], ascending=[False, False]).head(top_n)


leaf_summaries = []
for result in tree_probe_results:
    if result["task"] == "multiclass_bip_qrother_qrred":
        continue
    leaf_summaries.append(binary_leaf_summary(result))

pd.concat(leaf_summaries, ignore_index=True)
```

## 7G. Candidato externo: accesibilidad espacial a carga BIP

Objetivo: auditar si la friccion espacial para cargar BIP fisica aporta senal
para separar `QR_OTHER` de `BIP`. Estas variables vienen de puntos oficiales de
carga/retail/metro/centros deduplicados por coordenada y agregados a `ZONA777`.

Variables auditadas:

- disponibilidad en zona: `has_point`, `n_points`, `density_km2`;
- distancia desde centroide de zona al punto de carga mas cercano;
- tres anclajes: residencia (`zona_hogar`), origen top-1 y actividad top-1.

```{python}
#| label: block7g-bip-load-access-setup
print("label: block7g-bip-load-access-setup")

BIP_LOAD_ACCESS_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "audits" / "bip_load_access" / "bip_load_access_by_zona777.parquet"
print(f"bip load access path: {BIP_LOAD_ACCESS_PATH}")
```

```{python}
df_bip_bins = (

def add_bip_load_bins(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    for prefix, label in [
        ("home", "home"),
        ("origin_top1", "origin"),
        ("activity_top1", "activity"),
    ]:
        dist_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_dist_nearest_m"
        density_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_density_km2"
        n_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_n_points_zone"
        has_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_has_point_zone"

        out[f"{label}_bip_dist_q"] = qcut_series(out[dist_col], q=5, prefix=f"{label}_dist_Q")
        out[f"{label}_bip_density_q"] = qcut_series(out[density_col], q=5, prefix=f"{label}_dens_Q")
        out[f"{label}_bip_has_point_bin"] = out[has_col].map({0: "sin_punto", 1: "con_punto"})
        out[f"{label}_bip_n_points_bin"] = pd.cut(
            out[n_col],
            bins=[-0.001, 0, 1, 3, 6, float("inf")],
            labels=["0", "1", "2-3", "4-6", "7+"],
            include_lowest=True,
        ).astype("object")
    return out


df_bip_bins = add_bip_load_bins(df_bip_bins)

BIP_LOAD_BIN_VARS = [
    "home_bip_dist_q",
    "home_bip_density_q",

    "activity_bip_dist_q",

    "activity_bip_has_point_bin",

]
```

```{python}
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

df_bip_probe = (
    lf_bip_access_features
    .select(list(dict.fromkeys([
        "tipo_tarjeta", "is_qr_other",

    .to_pandas()

df_bip_probe = df_bip_probe.loc[df_bip_probe["tipo_tarjeta"] != "QR_RED"].copy()

# Reutilizar flags conductuales/socio-geograficas del probe 7F.
df_bip_probe = df_bip_probe.assign(
    recent_majority_2025=(df_bip_probe["share_trips_2025"] >= 0.75).astype(int),
    solo_2025=(df_bip_probe["share_trips_2025"] >= 0.999).astype(int),
    low_intensity_3_9=df_bip_probe["n_viajes"].between(3, 9).astype(int),
    very_low_intensity_3_4=df_bip_probe["n_viajes"].between(3, 4).astype(int),
    mid_intensity_10_19=df_bip_probe["n_viajes"].between(10, 19).astype(int),
    high_hora_std_q4_q5=(df_bip_probe["hora_std"] >= hora_std_q4_cut).astype(int),
    high_hora_std_q5=(df_bip_probe["hora_std"] >= hora_std_q5_cut).astype(int),
    pt_bajo_medio=df_bip_probe["share_lab_pt"].between(0, 0.75, inclusive="right").astype(int),
    no_lab_high=(df_bip_probe["share_no_lab"] > 0.75).astype(int),
    no_metro_bus=(df_bip_probe["share_trips_metro_bus"] == 0).astype(int),
    no_solo_metro=(df_bip_probe["share_trips_solo_metro"] == 0).astype(int),
    low_origin_entropy=(df_bip_probe["origin_zone_entropy"] <= entropy_q2_cut).astype(int),
    educ_q5=(df_bip_probe["res_share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro_z"] >= educ_q5_cut).astype(int),
    de_q1=(df_bip_probe["res_eod2012_share_hogares_de_income_proxy_z"] <= de_q1_cut).astype(int),
    disc_q1=(df_bip_probe["res_share_discapacidad_z"] <= disc_q1_cut).astype(int),
    edad_q5=(df_bip_probe["res_prom_edad_z"] >= edad_q5_cut).astype(int),
    parv_q5=(df_bip_probe["res_share_asistencia_parv_z"] >= parv_q5_cut).astype(int),
)
df_bip_probe = df_bip_probe.assign(
    recent_low_intensity=(
        df_bip_probe["recent_majority_2025"] & df_bip_probe["low_intensity_3_9"]
    ).astype(int),
    recent_high_hora_std=(

    ).astype(int),
    low_intensity_high_hora_std=(

    ).astype(int),

    ).astype(int),
    oriente_res_or_origin=(
        (df_bip_probe["home_macro_oriente"] == 1)
        | (df_bip_probe["origin_top1_macro_oriente"] == 1)
    ).astype(int),
)

for prefix in ["home", "origin_top1", "activity_top1"]:
    dist_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_dist_nearest_m"
    density_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_density_km2"
    has_col = f"{prefix}_bip_load_has_point_zone"
    short = "origin" if prefix == "origin_top1" else "activity" if prefix == "activity_top1" else "home"
    df_bip_probe[f"{short}_bip_no_point"] = (df_bip_probe[has_col] == 0).astype(int)
    df_bip_probe[f"{short}_bip_high_dist_q5"] = (
        df_bip_probe[dist_col] >= df_bip_probe[dist_col].quantile(0.80)
    ).astype(int)
    df_bip_probe[f"{short}_bip_low_density_q1"] = (
        df_bip_probe[density_col] <= df_bip_probe[density_col].quantile(0.20)
    ).astype(int)

BIP_TREE_FEATURES = [
    "home_bip_no_point",
    "home_bip_high_dist_q5",
    "home_bip_low_density_q1",
    "origin_bip_no_point",
    "origin_bip_high_dist_q5",
    "origin_bip_low_density_q1",
    "activity_bip_no_point",
    "activity_bip_high_dist_q5",
    "activity_bip_low_density_q1",
]

QR_OTHER_PROBE_BASE_FEATURES = TREE_PROBE_FEATURES_BEHAVIOR + [
    "edad_q5",
    "educ_q5",
    "home_macro_oriente",
    "origin_top1_macro_oriente",
]


def fit_binary_probe_with_features(df: pd.DataFrame, features: list[str], model_name: str) -> dict:
    data = df[["is_qr_other", *features]].copy()
    X = data[features]
    y = data["is_qr_other"].astype(int)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )

    tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
        min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
    )
    tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
    tree_proba = tree.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    logit = make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
    )
    logit.fit(X_train, y_train)
    logit_proba = logit.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    return {
        "feature_set": model_name,
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": y.mean(),
        "tree_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "tree_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "logit_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, logit_proba),
        "logit_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, logit_proba),
        "tree": tree,
        "features": features,
    }


probe_sets = [
    fit_binary_probe_with_features(
        df_bip_probe,
        QR_OTHER_PROBE_BASE_FEATURES,
        "baseline_flags",
    ),
    fit_binary_probe_with_features(
        df_bip_probe,
        QR_OTHER_PROBE_BASE_FEATURES + BIP_TREE_FEATURES,
        "baseline_plus_bip_access_flags",
    ),
    fit_binary_probe_with_features(
        df_bip_probe,
        QR_OTHER_PROBE_BASE_FEATURES + BIP_TREE_FEATURES + BIP_LOAD_FEATURES,
        "baseline_plus_bip_access_flags_continuous",
    ),
]

block7g_probe_metrics = pd.DataFrame([
    {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in {"tree", "features"}}
    for r in probe_sets
])
```

## 7G. Lectura pendiente

Este bloque se interpreta como prueba de hipotesis exploratoria:

- si las variables de accesibilidad BIP mejoran poco AUC/AP, quedan como
  control/sensibilidad territorial y no como eje principal;
- si mejoran especialmente `QR_OTHER vs BIP`, pasan a candidato fuerte para el
  set `ml_wide` y para una sensibilidad econometrica acotada;
- no usar `dist_nearest_m` como distancia individual exacta: es distancia desde
  centroide de `ZONA777`.

Lectura preliminar tras auditoria:

- El cruce parece sano: coordenadas plausibles, baja perdida fuera de `ZONA777`,
  cobertura alta en panel y control positivo contra macrozonas/centralidad.
- La hipotesis no se sostiene para el target: rankings, bins y probes muestran
  aporte casi nulo para `QR_OTHER vs BIP`.
- Variantes con conteos en radio y sin deduplicar tampoco cambian la conclusion.
- Decision: excluir de `logit_main`; mantener en `ml_wide` como bloque externo
  para descarte formal y control de robustez.

# 7H. Oferta, demanda e incertidumbre operacional

Objetivo: probar si el contexto operacional separa mejor `QR_OTHER vs BIP` o
`QR vs BIP`.

Este bloque usa un artefacto agregado por tarjeta. Construirlo antes de correr:

```bash
/Users/vicenteonetto/.local/share/mamba/envs/larch-env/bin/python scripts/audits/build_user_offer_demand_exposure.py --scope interannual_ml --force
```

Variables incluidas en este primer corte:

- demanda local observada por zona de origen y franja (`LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA`);
- oferta estructural por zona (`LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY`, `LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY`);
- frecuencia/headway observado en el paradero de origen para viajes que parten en bus o zona paga.

Nota: `metro_headways_master.parquet` existe y contiene `headway_secs`, pero no
se pega aun en este bloque porque requiere mapear cada viaje de Metro a
linea/sentido o definir una regla de agregacion por estacion. Se deja como
siguiente extension, no como supuesto implicito.

```{python}
    lf_offer_features
```

```{python}
    .collect()
    .to_pandas()
)
df_offer_probe = df_offer_probe.loc[df_offer_probe["tipo_tarjeta"] != "QR_RED"].copy()


def fit_binary_probe_with_imputation(df: pd.DataFrame, features: list[str], model_name: str) -> dict:
    data = df[["is_qr_other", *features]].copy()
    X = data[features]
    y = data["is_qr_other"].astype(int)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )

    tree = make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        DecisionTreeClassifier(
            max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
            min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
            class_weight="balanced",
            random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
        ),
    )
    tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
    tree_proba = tree.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    logit = make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
    )
    logit.fit(X_train, y_train)
    logit_proba = logit.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    return {
        "feature_set": model_name,
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": y.mean(),
        "tree_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "tree_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "logit_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, logit_proba),
        "logit_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, logit_proba),
    }


offer_probe_sets = [
    fit_binary_probe_with_imputation(
        df_offer_probe,
        OFFER_BASELINE_CONT_FEATURES,
        "baseline_continuous",
    ),
    fit_binary_probe_with_imputation(
        df_offer_probe,
        OFFER_BASELINE_CONT_FEATURES + OFFER_DEMAND_VARS,
        "baseline_plus_offer_demand",
    ),
]

block7h_offer_probe_metrics = pd.DataFrame(offer_probe_sets)
block7h_offer_probe_metrics
```

## 7H. Lectura pendiente

Este bloque debe leerse como prueba de hipotesis, no como conclusion causal:

- si el aporte incremental es bajo, las variables de oferta/demanda quedan como
  controles para `ml_wide`, no como eje principal;
- si mejora `QR_OTHER vs BIP`, revisar especialmente frecuencia/headway de bus
  y demanda local como candidatos de separacion;
- si solo mejora `QR_RED`, probablemente está capturando centralidad/Metro o
  capital digital territorial, no friccion BIP;
- siguiente extension: construir headway de Metro por estacion-linea-franja
  desde `metro_headways_master.parquet` o GTFS `frequencies.txt`.

# 7I. Inercia de ruta y repeticion de alternativas

Objetivo: probar si la adopcion QR se asocia a menor/mayor inercia de ruta.
Este bloque se inspira en Arriagada et al. sobre inercia en eleccion de rutas:
frecuencia historica de alternativas, repeticion de la ultima alternativa
(`stickiness`) y similitud de distribucion de rutas entre periodos.

Construir el artefacto antes de correr:

```bash
/Users/vicenteonetto/.local/share/mamba/envs/larch-env/bin/python scripts/audits/build_user_route_inertia.py --scope interannual_ml --force
```

Firmas de ruta:

- `coarse_route`: OD de zona + patron modal.
- `service_route`: OD de zona + patron modal + servicios observados.
- `stop_service_route`: OD de zona + patron modal + servicios + paraderos
  observados; se usa como sensibilidad porque puede ser mas ruidosa y costosa.
  Por defecto el builder la omite y deja `stop_service_route_*` nulo. Para
  activarla, usar `--include-stop-service` solo despues de validar el bloque
  principal.

```{python}
    bin_var = f"{ROUTE_INERTIA_LABELS[raw_var]}_q"
    df_route_bins[bin_var] = qcut_series(df_route_bins[raw_var], q=5, prefix="Q")
    ROUTE_BIN_VARS.append(bin_var)

route_bin_frames = []
for pair_name in ["qr_vs_bip", "qr_other_vs_bip", "qr_red_vs_other"]:
    for bin_var in ROUTE_BIN_VARS:
        route_bin_frames.append(bin_rates_for_pair(df_route_bins, pair_name, bin_var))

block7i_route_bin_rates = pd.concat(route_bin_frames, ignore_index=True)

MIN_ROUTE_BIN_CARDS = 20_000
block7i_route_bin_extremes = (
    block7i_route_bin_rates
    .query("n_cards >= @MIN_ROUTE_BIN_CARDS")
    .sort_values(["pair", "lift_vs_base"], ascending=[True, False])
    .groupby("pair")
    .head(20)
)
```

```{python}
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

if "fit_binary_probe_with_imputation" not in globals():
    def fit_binary_probe_with_imputation(df: pd.DataFrame, features: list[str], model_name: str) -> dict:
        data = df[["is_qr_other", *features]].copy()
        X = data[features]
        y = data["is_qr_other"].astype(int)
        X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
            X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
        )

        tree = make_pipeline(
            SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            DecisionTreeClassifier(
                max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
                min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
                class_weight="balanced",
                random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
            ),
        )
        tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
        tree_proba = tree.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

        logit = make_pipeline(
            SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
        )
        logit.fit(X_train, y_train)
        logit_proba = logit.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

        return {
            "feature_set": model_name,
            "n": len(data),
            "positive_rate": y.mean(),
            "tree_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, tree_proba),
            "tree_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, tree_proba),
            "logit_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, logit_proba),
            "logit_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, logit_proba),
        }
```

## 7I. Lectura del bloque

El cruce del artefacto de inercia es sano: `n_trips_panel` coincide exactamente
con `n_trips_route_artifact` y el mismatch por tarjeta es cero. Las firmas
`od_pair`, `coarse_route` y `service_route` tienen missing casi nulo. Las
variables `stop_service_route_*` quedan intencionalmente nulas porque la firma
paradero-servicio es una sensibilidad pesada y no forma parte del bloque
principal.

La variable interanual `service_route_rcs_2024_2025` conserva la senal mas
fuerte, pero tambien el caveat mas importante: exige usuarios observados en
ambos anos y deja cerca de 71.5% de missing en `QR_OTHER vs BIP`. Por eso se
mantiene como sensibilidad interanual, no como variable principal. La alternativa
`service_route_early_late_rcs` reduce el missing a cerca de 31.3% porque compara
la primera y segunda mitad del historial observado de cada tarjeta, exigiendo al
menos 3 viajes en cada mitad. Esta version es metodologicamente mas adecuada
para el set principal.

Lectura empirica:

- `QR_OTHER vs BIP`: la diversidad de ruta tiene senal moderada. `od_entropy_norm`
  y `coarse_route_entropy_norm` alcanzan AUC univariado cercano a 0.536-0.537.
  En bins, `service_route_entropy_norm` alto eleva la tasa de QR_OTHER vs BIP
  sobre la base. El probe confirma aporte incremental en logit: AUC sube de
  0.6176 a 0.6240 y average precision de 0.1896 a 0.1929. El arbol no mejora,
  consistente con redundancia parcial con recencia/intensidad/horario.
- `QR_RED vs QR_OTHER`: la senal va en sentido opuesto. QR_RED aparece mas
  asociado a mayor estabilidad temporal y menor entropia de rutas. El
  `service_route_rcs_2024_2025` alto tiene lift relevante, pero queda como
  sensibilidad por la restriccion de submuestra. `service_route_early_late_rcs`
  alto tambien separa, con cobertura bastante mayor.
- `QR vs BIP`: la senal existe, pero es mas debil que en las comparaciones
  especificas. La inercia parece ayudar mas a entender diferencias dentro del
  universo QR y a separar QR_OTHER de BIP que a explicar QR agregado.

Decision de modelamiento:

- Para `ml_wide`: incluir `service_route_entropy_norm`,
  `service_route_early_late_rcs` y `service_route_has_early_late_rcs`.
- Como sensibilidad interanual: incluir `service_route_rcs_2024_2025`, reportando
  explicitamente que cambia la base a usuarios presentes en ambos anos.
- Para `logit_main`: probar una especificacion parsimoniosa con
  `service_route_entropy_norm`; agregar `service_route_early_late_rcs` +
  `service_route_has_early_late_rcs` solo si se quiere representar estabilidad
  temporal de forma explicita.
- No usar `stop_service_route_*` en main por costo, ruido y missing estructural;
  dejarlo solo como posible sensibilidad futura.

# 7J. Interacciones e hibridos conductuales

Objetivo: probar si las senales debiles pero consistentes de bloques anteriores
se refuerzan cuando se combinan. Este bloque evita una busqueda exhaustiva de
interacciones: solo se prueban cruces definidos por mecanismo.

Familias:

- recencia + baja intensidad: posible cohorte/adopcion reciente;
- variabilidad horaria + recencia/intensidad: usuarios menos rutinarios;
- diversidad/inercia de rutas + recencia/intensidad: menor habito de ruta o
  mayor exploracion;
- territorio/socio + estabilidad: perfil QR_RED mas territorialmente marcado.

```{python}
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


def fit_binary_probe_for_target(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    features: list[str],
    target_col: str,
    model_name: str,
    task_name: str,
) -> dict:
    data = df[[target_col, *features]].copy()
    X = data[features]
    y = data[target_col].astype(int)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )

    tree = make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        DecisionTreeClassifier(
            max_depth=TREE_MAX_DEPTH,
            min_samples_leaf=TREE_MIN_LEAF,
            class_weight="balanced",
            random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
        ),
    )
    tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
    tree_proba = tree.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    logit = make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
    )
    logit.fit(X_train, y_train)
    logit_proba = logit.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    return {
        "task": task_name,
        "feature_set": model_name,
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": y.mean(),
        "tree_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "tree_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, tree_proba),
        "logit_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, logit_proba),
        "logit_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, logit_proba),
    }


HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES = [
    "service_route_entropy_norm",
    "service_route_early_late_rcs",
    "service_route_has_early_late_rcs",
]
HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES = [
    v for v in HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES
    if v in lf_hybrid_features.collect_schema().names()
]

HYBRID_BASELINE_FEATURES = [
    v for v in ROUTE_BASELINE_CONT_FEATURES
    if v in lf_hybrid_features.collect_schema().names()
]

df_hybrid_probe = (
    lf_hybrid_features
    .select([
        "tipo_tarjeta", "is_qr", "is_qr_other", "is_qr_red",
        *HYBRID_BASELINE_FEATURES,
        *HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES,
        *HYBRID_FEATURES,
    ])
    .collect()
    .to_pandas()
)

hybrid_probe_rows = []
for task_name, target_col, mask in [
    ("qr_other_vs_bip", "is_qr_other", df_hybrid_probe["tipo_tarjeta"] != "QR_RED"),
    ("qr_red_vs_other", "is_qr_red", df_hybrid_probe["is_qr"] == 1),
]:
    df_task = df_hybrid_probe.loc[mask].copy()
    hybrid_probe_rows.append(fit_binary_probe_for_target(
        df_task,
        HYBRID_BASELINE_FEATURES,
        target_col,
        "baseline_continuous",
        task_name,
    ))
    hybrid_probe_rows.append(fit_binary_probe_for_target(
        df_task,
        HYBRID_BASELINE_FEATURES + HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES,
        target_col,
        "baseline_plus_route_core",
        task_name,
    ))
    hybrid_probe_rows.append(fit_binary_probe_for_target(
        df_task,
        HYBRID_BASELINE_FEATURES + HYBRID_ROUTE_CORE_FEATURES + HYBRID_FEATURES,
        target_col,
        "baseline_plus_route_core_hybrids",
        task_name,
    ))

block7j_hybrid_probe_metrics = pd.DataFrame(hybrid_probe_rows)
```

## 7J. Lectura del bloque

Las interacciones aportan senal, especialmente para `QR_OTHER vs BIP`. El mejor
cruce univariado es `recent_service_entropy`: AUC cercano a 0.552 y lift top 10
de 1.33. Esto mejora tanto a la diversidad de ruta sola como a las banderas de
recencia/baja intensidad por separado, por lo que el mecanismo compuesto es
coherente: usuarios recientes con rutas mas diversas tienen mayor probabilidad
de QR_OTHER frente a BIP.

En bins, los perfiles mas enriquecidos para `QR_OTHER vs BIP` son:

- `low_intensity_high_hora_std = 1`: tasa QR_OTHER 0.199 vs base 0.135,
  lift 1.47;
- `recent_high_hora_std = 1`: tasa 0.195, lift 1.44;
- `recent_low_intensity = 1`: tasa 0.182, lift 1.35;
- `solo2025_low_intensity = 1`: tasa 0.180, lift 1.34;
- `recent_service_entropy` alto/intermedio: lift cercano a 1.29.

Para `QR_RED vs QR_OTHER`, la logica es distinta. Las hibridas territoriales y
socioeconomicas dominan:

- `oriente_educ_q5 = 1`: tasa QR_RED 0.314 vs base 0.141, lift 2.23;
- `educ_q5_early_late_rcs`: lift 1.89;
- `oriente_early_late_rcs`: lift 1.79;
- `oriente_high_hora_std = 1`: lift 1.71.

El probe confirma valor incremental para logit. En `QR_OTHER vs BIP`, el AUC
sube de 0.6209 con `route_core` a 0.6282 con hibridas, y el average precision
sube de 0.1907 a 0.1998. En `QR_RED vs QR_OTHER`, el AUC sube de 0.6945 a
0.6982, aunque el average precision casi no cambia. El arbol chico no mejora,
probablemente porque ya captura estos cortes con splits base.

Decision:

- Para `ml_wide`: incluir hibridas seleccionadas, especialmente
  `hyb_recent_service_entropy`, `hyb_recent_low_intensity`,
  `hyb_solo2025_low_intensity`, `hyb_recent_high_hora_std`,
  `hyb_low_intensity_high_hora_std` y `hyb_oriente_educ_q5`.
- Para `logit_main`: no incluir hibridas de forma masiva. Si se usa una
  interaccion defendible para `QR_OTHER vs BIP`, la candidata principal es
  `hyb_recent_service_entropy`. Para `QR_RED vs QR_OTHER`, `hyb_oriente_educ_q5`
  queda como sensibilidad interpretativa, no como control causal principal.

# 7K. Evaluacion binaria formal: QR vs BIP

Objetivo: evaluar el problema binario agregado `QR` vs `BIP` con los mejores
bloques acumulados. Esta especificacion es util como modelo predictivo general,
pero mezcla dos mecanismos distintos: `QR_OTHER` parece mas asociado a
recencia/diversidad/uso ocasional, mientras `QR_RED` tiene un perfil mas
territorial/socioeconomico. Por eso las metricas binarias se reportan como
desempeno agregado, no como interpretacion causal unica.

Metricas principales:

- ROC-AUC: separabilidad global.
- PR-AUC / average precision: metrica prioritaria por desbalance del positivo.
- lift y precision en top 10% y top 5%: utilidad practica como ranking.

```{python}
#| label: block7k-binary-model-setup
print("label: block7k-binary-model-setup")

from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


def top_lift_metrics(y_true: pd.Series, score: pd.Series, top_share: float) -> dict:
    y_arr = pd.Series(y_true).astype(int).reset_index(drop=True)
    s_arr = pd.Series(score).reset_index(drop=True)
    n_top = max(1, int(len(y_arr) * top_share))
    top_idx = s_arr.sort_values(ascending=False).head(n_top).index
    base_rate = y_arr.mean()
    precision = y_arr.loc[top_idx].mean()
    return {
        f"precision_top{int(top_share * 100)}": precision,
        f"lift_top{int(top_share * 100)}": precision / base_rate if base_rate else None,
    }


def fit_binary_model_probe(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    features: list[str],
    model_name: str,
    model_type: str,
) -> dict:
    data = df[["is_qr", *features]].copy()
    X = data[features]
    y = data["is_qr"].astype(int)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y
    )

    if model_type == "logit":
        model = make_pipeline(
            SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
        )
    elif model_type == "hgb":
        model = make_pipeline(
            SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
                max_iter=150,
                learning_rate=0.06,
                max_leaf_nodes=31,
                l2_regularization=0.05,
                random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE,
            ),
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"model_type no soportado: {model_type}")

    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    pred = (proba >= 0.5).astype(int)
    metrics = {
        "feature_set": model_name,
        "model_type": model_type,
        "n": len(data),
        "positive_rate": y.mean(),
        "n_features": len(features),
        "roc_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, proba),
        "pr_auc_avg_precision": average_precision_score(y_test, proba),
        "balanced_accuracy_at_050": balanced_accuracy_score(y_test, pred),
    }
    metrics.update(top_lift_metrics(y_test, proba, 0.10))
    metrics.update(top_lift_metrics(y_test, proba, 0.05))
    return metrics
```

```{python}
BEST_BINARY_MODEL_TYPE = "logit"

best_features = binary_feature_sets[BEST_BINARY_FEATURE_SET]
data_best = df_binary_probe[["is_qr", *best_features]].copy()
X_best = data_best[best_features]
y_best = data_best["is_qr"].astype(int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X_best, y_best, test_size=0.30, random_state=TREE_RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y_best
)

best_model = make_pipeline(
    SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
    StandardScaler(),
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=300, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"),
)
best_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
best_score = best_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

df_binary_deciles = pd.DataFrame({
    "y": y_test.reset_index(drop=True),
    "score": best_score,
})
df_binary_deciles["score_decile"] = pd.qcut(
    df_binary_deciles["score"],
    q=10,
    labels=[f"D{i}" for i in range(1, 11)],
    duplicates="drop",
)

block7k_binary_deciles = (
    df_binary_deciles
    .groupby("score_decile", observed=True)
    .agg(
        n=("y", "size"),
        qr_rate=("y", "mean"),
        score_min=("score", "min"),
        score_max=("score", "max"),
    )
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("score_decile", ascending=False)
)
block7k_binary_deciles["lift_vs_base"] = block7k_binary_deciles["qr_rate"] / y_test.mean()
block7k_binary_deciles
```
